verdict.rationale: Muse offers 'side chats' for separate topic context as projects grow complex and a persistent VM/file system where all files and generated memory are stored and shared across the agent's work, which partially supports organizing related chats/files with shared context. However, there is no explicit 'project' or 'space' construct with custom instructions, and no evidence of grouping side chats together or setting per-space instructions. Missing for 10: explicit project/space object with custom instructions, ability to group multiple chats+files under one named space, evidence of instructions propagating across grouped chats.
